verdict: After a Win11 24H2 in-place upgrade, `Check online for updates from Microsoft Update` is hidden. The TS set a local GPO to prevent internet update contact, and the registry value persists after completion.
fix: Add a final `Run Command Line` step at the end of the TS: `reg delete 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' /v DoNotConnectToWindowsUpdateInternetLocations /f`. Or set the local GPO `Remove access to all Windows Update features` to `Not Configured` as the post-step. Test via `Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' DoNotConnectToWindowsUpdateInternetLocations` -- the value should not exist after TS completes.
